purpose: make T and TN differ in semantic fit rather than donor identity, truth-status labeling, provenance, target-slot coverage, or payload density
neutral_context_notice: 이 설계 맥락은 검증되지 않았을 수 있다.

T_materialization.scene_slot_policy: replace source scene numbers with target-relative slot_1..slot_N

TN_materialization.semantic_source: frozen within-work cyclic +1 donor from prereg v1.0
TN_materialization.scene_note_policy: for every target slot j choose nearest normalized donor scene-note index; duplicate when donor shorter, sample when donor longer; preserve proposition text verbatim
TN_materialization.donor_to_target_reference_policy: map donor-local scene references to nearest normalized target slot and deduplicate

text_sanitization.future_episode_label_policy: renderer-facing plant/payoff statements must not expose explicit future episode identifiers; deterministically replace literal EP-number labels with [LATER] without otherwise rewriting semantic text

density_invariants: T.scene_notes count == target scene slot count
TN.scene_notes count == target scene slot count
all T/TN scene_notes functional_propositions are nonempty
T and TN use identical target_slot_id and target slot numbering envelope for a given anchor
validity_rule: result is invalid if T/TN truth-status notices differ, donor identity/mismatch label is exposed, or T/TN target-slot coverage differs
